responsibility: This is the master Texinfo source for the GCC internals manual. It defines the top-level organization of developer documentation and includes chapters covering contribution workflow, portability, ABI interface, libgcc, front-end architecture, source tree and build system, option files, pass structure, internal representations such as GENERIC, GIMPLE, Tree SSA and RTL, CFG and loop infrastructure, machine descriptions and target hooks, plugins, LTO, analyzer internals, and UX guidelines.
